title: A Movie Review
text:
Last week, Lucas watched a new science fiction film at the cinema. He thought the story was exciting and the actors were very good. However, the music was too loud for him.

Lucas wrote a short review on the internet. He gave the film three stars because the ending was confusing. He recommended it to his friends who like fast action films.

questions.text: What did Lucas think about the story?
How many stars did Lucas give the film?
What can you infer about Lucas's opinion of the film?
options: He liked it overall but had some complaints
He did not watch the whole film
He thought it was the best film ever

questions.text: Why might Lucas recommend the film to his friends?
options: Because some of them enjoy fast action films
Because the film is very short

vocabulary.definition: a written opinion about a film, product, or service
making you feel happy and interested
people who perform in films or plays
the last part of a story or film

paragraph_translations: No semana passada, Lucas assistiu a um novo filme de ficção científica no cinema. Ele achou a história empolgante e os atores muito bons. No entanto, a música estava alta demais para ele.
Lucas escreveu uma avaliação curta na internet. Ele deu três estrelas ao filme porque o final era confuso. Ele recomendou o filme aos amigos que gostam de filmes de ação rápidos.
